title: Layout
description: Everything scribe knows about the text in one image.

image.description: The raster the coordinates in this layout refer to.

lines.description: The lines of text, in reading order.

version.description:
The version of the model this document was written against.

The current one is `LAYOUT_VERSION`.

Char.description: A single character within a word.

bbox.description: The axis-aligned bounds of the character.

confidence.description:
How sure the recogniser is of this character, from 0 to 1, when it
says.

text.description: The character itself, as one grapheme cluster.

height.description: The height of the image in pixels.

width.description: The width of the image in pixels.

bbox.description: The axis-aligned bounds of the line.

confidence.description: How sure the recogniser is of this line, from 0 to 1, when it says.

rotated_box.description: The oriented bounds of the line.

text.description: The text of the line, ready to be used as-is by a renderer.

words.description: The words of the line, in reading order.

Rect.description:
An axis-aligned rectangle in image pixels, with the origin at the top left
and y increasing downwards.

width.description: The width, extending to the right.

x.description: The x coordinate of the left edge.

y.description: The y coordinate of the top edge.

RotatedBox.description:
An oriented rectangle in image pixels: a box of `width` by `height` centred
on `(cx, cy)` and turned by `angle_deg`.

The angle is measured from the positive x axis to the box's width axis and
is positive clockwise as seen on screen, which is what SVG's `rotate()`
does in the same y-down coordinate system.

angle_deg.description:
The rotation in degrees, clockwise-positive, normalised to
`(-180, 180]`.

cx.description: The x coordinate of the centre.

cy.description: The y coordinate of the centre.

height.description: The extent along the box's height axis.

width.description: The extent along the box's width axis.

bbox.description: The axis-aligned bounds of the word.

chars.description:
The characters of the word, in reading order.

Renderers position words by default; this is here for the ones that
want finer control, and may be empty when the recogniser offers
nothing per character.

confidence.description: How sure the recogniser is of this word, from 0 to 1, when it says.

rotated_box.description: The oriented bounds of the word.
